visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a top-down view of a dark grey plastic shopping cart. Inside are two bottles of Ramon Bilbao red wine (one with a yellow foil top), a blue container of white button mushrooms, a bag of fresh green leafy herbs, and four loose red tomatoes resting on the mesh bottom. (2) Sliced white mushrooms are dry-sautéed in a black non-stick frying pan. The mushrooms are crowded in the pan, and light steam is visible as they cook on a black induction cooktop in a modern kitchen setting. (3) A hand holds a clear glass bottle with a gold cap, pouring bright golden-green olive oil into a large stainless steel pot. The pot already contains chunks of fresh red tomatoes and a wooden spatula. (4) The camera shows two heating elements simultaneously: the large pot on the left with simmering tomatoes and a smaller pan on the right with the sautéed mushrooms. The lighting is bright and even studio-style indoor light. (5) A hand uses a wooden spatula to transfer the sautéed sliced mushrooms from the pan into the tomato mixture in the stainless steel pot, stirring them together to form a chunky sauce. (6) Six large, whole white mushroom caps are placed top-down into the black frying pan to sear. The surrounding countertop is white and clean, with the olive oil bottle visible in the background. (7) A hand reaches into a small glass jar to grab a pinch of white salt, which is then sprinkled over the bubbling tomato and mushroom sauce in the large pot. (8) In the background pan, two eggs are being fried, while the tomato sauce in the foreground pot continues to simmer and release steam. The person uses the wooden spatula to check the consistency. (9) Two rectangular foil packets of Douyoubo soy sauce are shown close-up on a light wooden cutting board. The packaging is white with black and red text. (10) A hand tears one of the soy sauce packets and pours the dark brown liquid into a white electric pot where thin noodles are cooking in a light broth. (11) A stainless steel ladle is used to scoop the thick, red tomato and mushroom sauce from the pot and pour it over a bowl of cooked thin yellow noodles. (12) The final dish is presented: a white bowl of tomato and mushroom noodle soup, topped with a perfectly fried egg and a single slice of red chili for garnish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the ambient murmur of a supermarket. A female voice speaks clearly, directing someone to find something. There is a slight echo consistent with a large indoor space. (2) Upbeat acoustic guitar music fades in. A sharp, rhythmic sizzling sound (broadband transient) starts as mushrooms hit a hot pan. The speaker's voice becomes more enthusiastic and louder, matching the energetic BGM. (3) The sound of pouring liquid is clearly audible as a continuous splashing sound. The female speaker describes the fresh olive oil with a bright, high-arousal pitch contour. (4) Simmering and bubbling sounds (mid-frequency noise) dominate the background layer. The speaker discusses oil quantity with a slightly teasing and humorous inflection. The guitar rhythm provides a steady underlying beat. (5) A series of metallic percussive sounds occur as a ladle taps against a stainless steel pot. The speaker maintains a fast speech rate, detailing the vegetable preparation. (6) A distinct 'hiss' of searing food is heard. The female voice remains steady and professional, but warm. The music continues without any gaps or structural pauses. (7) Sharp crinkling sounds (high-frequency transients) indicate the tearing of plastic packets. A soft 'drip' and splashing sound follows. The speaker continues her narrative about adding soy sauce. (8) Clinking of ceramic and metal occurs as the food is plated. The speaker's voice drops slightly in volume and pitch as she concludes by naming the dish, accompanied by a final rhythmic guitar flourish.
